changesProposed.name: Engine Ventures

verified.name: Engine Ventures
verified.thesis: Engine Ventures is a venture capital firm focused on early-stage Tough Tech companies that solve the world's most important challenges through breakthrough science and engineering. The firm invests in companies developing hardware-based technologies across deep tech fields including biotech, robotics, green energy, agriculture, manufacturing, material science, and quantum computing.
verified.notes: Engine Ventures is the separate venture capital arm that spun out from The Engine in 2023. The Engine itself is a nonprofit incubator and accelerator founded by MIT in 2016. Sources [4], [5], and [6] are unrelated news articles and provide no information about Engine Ventures.

changesProposed.name: Y Combinator

verified.name: Y Combinator
verified.thesis: Y Combinator invests $500,000 per company ($125,000 for 7% equity on post-money SAFE and $375,000 on uncapped SAFE with MFN clause) in startups selected four times per year. Founders move to San Francisco for three months of intensive mentorship, office hours, and community support, culminating in Demo Day where companies present to investors.
verified.notes: Garry Tan became president and CEO in January 2023. Jared Friedman became managing partner in March 2024, succeeding Michael Seibel. Headquarters relocated from Mountain View to San Francisco in spring 2023. Program runs four times per year (winter, spring, summer, fall). Source [3] is not relevant to Y Combinator firm data and was excluded.
